title: Fake USPS delivery text → RED (Scam)

request.text: USPS: Your package is on hold due to an incomplete address. Update within 12 hrs: https://usps-package-hold.example/update

explanation: [TEAM DEMO DOMAIN] is filled with the harmless placeholder usps-package-hold.example (.example is an IANA-reserved TLD that can never be registered or resolve). No lookalike domain was purchased and no fake USPS site exists. Expected evidence: the domain is not usps.com, does not resolve / has no registration record, deadline pressure. If Person 2's link tool reports 'no WHOIS record', the narrator must describe that honestly as 'this domain doesn't exist as a real USPS site', NOT as 'registered 2 days ago'.
